decision_rules.evaluation_valid: all 45 unique frozen rows complete with identical identities across arms, zero exceptions, finite legal actions, nonzero Base forwards, and nonzero Prior forwards/corrections in the Prior arm
decision_rules.base_competent: standard successes >=8/15 and >=1 success on every task
decision_rules.repeatable_delay_gap: standard minus delayed Base >=3/15, >=3 matched standard-success/delayed-failure identities spanning >=2 tasks
decision_rules.prior_improves: Prior minus delayed Base >=2/15, >=2 delayed failures recovered, <=1 delayed Base success regressed, and nonzero live Prior correction
decision_rules.prior_saturates: prior_improves and (Prior successes >= standard successes-1 or <=1 matched standard-success/Prior-failure identity remains)
decision_rules.residual_remains: prior_improves and standard minus Prior >=2/15 with >=2 matched residual identities spanning >=2 tasks
